maddeler.e:
تهايأت (form VI)
# تَهَايَأْتُ (tahāyaʔtu) /ta.haː.jaʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَهَايَأَ (tahāyaʔa)
# تَهَايَأْتَ (tahāyaʔta) /ta.haː.jaʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَهَايَأَ (tahāyaʔa)
# تَهَايَأْتِ (tahāyaʔti) /ta.haː.jaʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَهَايَأَ (tahāyaʔa)
# تَهَايَأَتْ (tahāyaʔat) /ta.haː.ja.ʔat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
